name: run-open-product-betterment
job: Run open product betterment: scout high-EV work, land the full batch, re-measure until the high-value frontier is empty.

inScope: Scouting enough evidence to rank leverage
Admitting every material unblocked high-EV item
Implementing the full batch with atomic commits and revert-safe PRs
Verifying with original oracles and re-scouting until idle
outOfScope: Preference for small tidy PRs as capacity
Faking a goal store when no continuity surface exists

inputs: Outcomes that matter now and quality anchors
Hard floors and highest pains or bets
outputs: Full batch of high-EV unblocked items landed
Fresh scout showing empty high-value frontier or named parks

permissions: delivery access on the owning layer

failureSemantics: Only evidence-based parks are allowed (external wait, authority pending, dependency blocked, safety hold); one PR, one batch, local green, or improved-a-bit is never idle; budgets come from host or user only.

outcome.observable: A standing betterment cycle lands every material unblocked high-EV item in complete revert-safe batches with original-oracle verification, and completes only after a fresh scout shows an empty high-value frontier or named evidence parks.
